title: Google Workspace (Admin SDK, service account with domain-wide delegation and read-only scopes)

checks.title: Every active user is enrolled in 2-Step Verification
checks.scope: Enrollment only; the second factor's kind (security key or not) is not visible.

checks.title: 2-Step Verification is enforced for every active user
checks.scope: Enforcement per user as the Directory API reports it (isEnforcedIn2Sv).

checks.title: Every super or delegated admin is enrolled in 2-Step Verification
checks.scope: Admins in the Directory API sense (isAdmin, isDelegatedAdmin).

checks.title: At most --google-max-super-admins active users are super admins
checks.scope: Super admins only; delegated admin roles are not counted.

checks.title: No active user has gone --google-stale-days days without signing in
checks.scope: Suspended and archived users are reported, not judged; users never signed in are judged by their creation date.

checks.title: The Admin console audit (Reports API) is readable and not empty
checks.scope: Admin activity only; retention and export to a SIEM are not visible.
